title: A DRONE FILMED UNITED'S FIRST POCHETTINO SESSION. 8 MILLION VIEWS.
description:
Pochettino's first United training was meant to be secret. Eight million views say otherwise.

Twelve minutes of tactical drills, filmed from above. Finally, something United could not mark.

The operator apologised and took it down. Legal flight, unethical filming, they said. Liverpool's Andoni Iraola said it should not be legal. Even rivals want drones grounded.

United will not sue this time, but may next time. Pochettino's first game is at Anfield on the 22nd.

Should filming a team's training from a drone be banned? Ban it or leave it? Vote in the comments.
